correctness.rationale: I independently generated every matching by deleting the least remaining vertex or pairing it with one of its remaining neighbors. Using the specified edge order and pivots, batch pairing followed by independent depth-first cycle detection gave face counts including the empty simplex (1,27,279,1399,3558,4338,2100,276), 5937 disjoint covers, all 11977 nonempty faces and 55209 directed incidences visited without a directed cycle, and critical counts one in degree 0 and 102 in degree 4. Forman's theorem now gives a CW complex with those cells: every four-cell attaches to a point, yielding the integral wedge, not merely a homology computation. The five triangles are the only triangle cycles and their adjacency graph is P5; the longitudinal matching fixes the row bijection on all columns once chosen on one column, giving precisely S3 times C2. For a fixed face with j edges and k permutation orbits, its contribution to the reduced simplicial trace is (-1)^(j-1)(-1)^(j-k)=(-1)^(k-1), also correct for the augmented empty face. A separate recursion on disjoint permitted edge orbits recovered the six traces (102,0,0;12,2,0); concentration in even degree four identifies them with the homology character. Inner products over the six classes give (10,7,9,8,19,15); all irreducibles are realized over Q. Independent exact replay: python3 /workspace/review_work/reproduce_5.py. The frozen checker was inspected, not executed.

value.rationale: This is a finite boundary-condition benchmark for the width-three matching-complex problem: at the same five layers the indexed open strip has sixteen four-spheres, while closing the width-three section yields 102. The exact acyclic certificate distinguishes a wedge from homology-only evidence, and the full row/reversal action makes it an equivariant benchmark as well. For example, the row action alone is seventeen copies of the regular rational S3 representation, but the trace 2 at transposition times reversal is additional information not available from this restriction or the rank. No claim for all lengths is needed for this precise comparison.
